_README: OPTIONAL CLAUDE ADAPTER ONLY. Merge selected keys into ~/.claude/settings.json; never replace the file. Back it up first and remove every key starting with _ before saving.
_comment_hooks: PreToolUse guard = no Fable subagents (Fable is the architect, not the worker). SessionStart = inject the ponytail posture into every session.
_comment_compact: Token budget before Claude Code auto-compacts the conversation. Higher = fewer context resets, more tokens per request. 750000 is a deliberate 'don't crash' setting for very long agent sessions; lower it (e.g. 450000) if you'd rather pay less.
_comment_effort: Reasoning depth. xhigh is deep but slower/pricier; 'high' is a fine default.
_comment_plugins: Legacy optional Claude plugins. Current Codex workflow skills do not require these and use Superpowers only when explicitly requested.
